bio.text: Larry Lambert has represented the 7th District in the Delaware House of Representatives since 2020.
Lambert is a lifelong resident of Claymont, attended Brandywine High School, and holds a B.A. in Communications from Temple University.
Lambert worked as an art teacher for eight years at the Claymont Boys & Girls Club and then in corporate banking for nine years.
